utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already set a date and drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I haven’t set those yet. If you remind me what we need, I can help get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We need a date, a drop-off spot, and a simple list of what people can bring. Can you pick a day and place, and I’ll help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, so I’m counting on your update to catch me up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the details yet either—I’m still waiting on the update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m just trying to make sure I know the time and drop-off spot before I head over. If you check with them, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still not sure it’s on, then? I’d rather confirm the time and drop-off spot before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — I’d rather have the time and drop-off spot confirmed first so I don’t make a wasted trip.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t seen the repair drive location posted, but I’m watching for it. If you hear the time or place first, send it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll pass along the time and place as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I spot the location first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center works for me—what time were you thinking? I can help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday morning at 9 works for me. I’ll bring the repair list and keep things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 works for me too. I’ll plan around the school schedule and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I’m still lining up helpers and tools for the repair drive, and I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as the time gets set. If you can sort donated tools or check off the repair list, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort donated tools and check off the repair list. Just let me know when you’ve got the time set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as the time and drop-off spot are set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — still on for this weekend, and folks are bringing tools, bikes, and small appliances. I’ll send you the time and drop-off spot as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just send me the time and drop-off spot when you have them, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the time and drop-off spot as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning works—just tell me the main thing you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — just help sort the donated tools and load the boxes. If you can bring gloves, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and help load the boxes. I’ll bring gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep the list organized and spread the word that we still need screws, duct tape, glue, and spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll keep the repair drive list updated and note Sunday at the community center. If anything else turns up, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep everything organized and let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center. If more supplies come in, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Mara — the repair drive is still on this weekend, and folks are bringing in tools, bikes, and small appliances. If you’ve got something needing a fix, I’d swing by early so you can catch the good volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by early. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — see you there, Mara, and bring whatever needs a little fixing!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up the helpers and tools for the repair drive, and I’ll let everyone know what’s next once the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m sorting the tool list and who can bring what, and I’ll share the repair drive details once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — that sounds great. I’ll keep everyone posted and share the next steps once the time is set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I’m still figuring out a date. If I hear anything extra, I’ll pass it along for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — keep me posted when you lock in a date for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’m still sorting out the date, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s the weekend repair drive — folks are bringing in tools, bikes, and small appliances. If you’ve got something needing a fix, I’d swing by early so you can catch the good volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by early then and see if I can get my old lamp fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s a good call — the early fixers are usually the best. Bring the lamp and I’ll point you to the right table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s start with the tool list and who can bring what. I’ll keep it simple and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the repair drive location and time, and I’ll keep track of them as soon as they show up. If you’ve got the tool list, send that along too and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got the tool list ready: hammer, screwdriver set, wrench, pliers, tape measure, and a drill if someone has one. I’ll send the full list over, and we can fill in who’s bringing what once the location and time are set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ve got the schedule organized. What would you like to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d like to start by checking the schedule so I can help where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll walk you through the Sunday schedule at the community center, and we can spot the busiest gaps first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’m really grateful for the help. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out for the next update and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — if you can, start with light cleanup near the community center and any basic fixes you spot. I’ll swing by and point you to whatever still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll start with the community center cleanup and keep an eye out for easy fixes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the weekend repair drive — I’ve got it mixed up a bit. I can swing by early and bring a few odds and ends if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would help a lot — thanks, Oren. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll get the word out to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll check my notes and send you the time and place as soon as I find them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering screws, duct tape, glue, and any spare tools folks can lend. If you’ve got anything extra, I can add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend a drill and a hammer, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the location and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ve added the drill and hammer to the list. Once we have the location and time, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring the drill and hammer for the repair drive—just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that’d be really helpful. I’m still checking with folks on the date, but I’ll let you know where to drop them off soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just send me the drop-off spot when you know it, and I’ll bring the drill and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works better for me. What time should I tell people to come?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday morning works — tell people to come at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll tell folks Sunday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up the helpers and tools for the repair drive, and I’ll keep everyone posted as the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — could you share the repair drive details first, especially the time and what helpers or tools you still need? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the time pinned down yet — I’m still checking with folks. For helpers and tools, I could use a few extra hands and basic repair supplies, and I’ll share the final details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—what time and drop-off spot did we settle on again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Still happening, right? Saturday at 9 — where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 9 sounds right — I think we said the community center parking lot. Sorry, I keep mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already set a date and drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, I’m still helping spread the word and keep everyone in the loop. Once we lock down the date and drop-off spot, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — please let me know as soon as you set both the date and drop-off spot.
